authentication.token_refresh_notes: Access tokens expire after 24 hours. Using refresh token will invalidate the old one and return a new refresh token.

rate_limiting.description: Deputy API limits single responses to maximum 500 records. No specific rate limiting mentioned in documentation, but reasonable throttling recommended.

query_config.notes: Deputy Resource API uses POST method with start/max pagination

response_wrapper.notes: Deputy API returns data directly as array with _DPMetaData object containing system information

datetime_fields.description: Deputy uses Unix timestamps for datetime fields

id_fields.description: Deputy uses integer IDs for most entities

api_versions.notes: Most endpoints use v1, some specialized endpoints like Agreed Hours and Sales Metrics use v2

authentication_notes.refresh_behavior: Refresh tokens are invalidated when used, new refresh token returned
